prompt: There's an Apache-style access log at access.log in this directory. Write a script that parses it and produces report.json with exactly this shape: a top-level object with two keys, "status_counts" and "top_paths". "status_counts" must be an object mapping each HTTP status code seen in the log (as a string, e.g. "200") to the number of requests with that status code. "top_paths" must be a JSON array of the 3 request paths with the most requests, ordered from most requests to fewest, where each array entry is an object with keys "path" (the request path, e.g. "/index.html") and "count" (the number of requests for that path). Run your script so report.json exists in this directory with the finished report.
